newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HARJU ELEKTER TO SEEK BOURSE LISTING-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: HARJU ELEKTER TO SEEK BOURSE LISTING-REPORT.

text.p: Manufacturing company Harju Elekter will seek a listing on the main list of the Tallinn stock exchange in autumn, Aripaev business newspaper said on Wednesday.
The company, based in Tallinn, has signed an agreement with Investeerimispank for the listing, the newspaper added.
The company makes electrical cables and wiring systems for Scania and Volvo trucks and buses and for Nokia radio telephones and telephone exchanges.
The company also makes fire-proof security doors as its third main area of production.
The company's 1997 first-half turnover compared to 1996 rose 43 percent to reach 43.7 million kroons.
The company's 1996 profit was 8.7 million kroons and turover was 72.7 million kroons.
